key_notes: Key 1 (t=6.35s): Initial archival pose of bee; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=7.47s): Mid-sequence articulation of bee; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=8.71s): Peak dynamic extension of bee over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=9.95s): Follow-through and settle of bee with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of bee (6.35s..9.95s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
